title: 第五章 、营救小姐妹，打脸女主
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

米樱昭雪察觉到自己犯下的错误，连忙找补回来，将话题转移到别处。

“嗯，我记得这里早饭六点钟，午饭十一点，晚饭五点钟开饭，每次开饭时间限时一个小时，我们快去餐厅那边吃饭，晚了就要饿肚子。”

狼女双手伸长拉走处于端木棠梨身后的米樱昭雪，速度极快顺着过道往外走。

“小雪都没有说过要和你一起去，你直接拖着人走，太不礼貌了。”

端木棠梨以为事情告一段落，精神松懈了一下，随后意识到不对劲，又提起来。

只是没想到怪物趁着她那一丝松懈功夫，借着米樱昭雪话头，将人直接给掳走了，心里那叫一个急。

要是没诡，那个诡异何故要把小姐妹拖出去，想必这里有她所不知道的死亡规则在里面，不能让人出去。

眼见人就要被狼女带出这个包厢，端木棠梨灵机一动，尝试借用它们的死亡规则，对付幽灵生物。

如果能行得通，她们在里世界就有一分活下去的机会。

“大小姐莫着急，我跟你仆人这就给你弄吃的去。”

显然由人转化为成的幽灵生物，比起里世界原由的诡异智商要更高。

在见自己已经无法直接将人拖走，立即又想出来一个法子，想要把端木棠梨给哄骗住，直接拽走米樱昭雪饱餐一顿。

“哼，你算老几，本小姐做事何须你指指点点，还不快点把我的人放下来。”

端木棠梨见来软的不行，干脆硬着头发学着刚才富贵震烨样子强横留人，希望这样子能震慑住诡异，将小伙伴给救回来。

庆幸的是，端木棠梨学得有模有样，如同一个真正的富家千金，狠狠震慑住魑魅魍魉，断掉它们对小伙伴肉身的贪婪念头，恋恋不舍将人给放了。

“大小姐勿怒，小的这不是担忧你肚子饿久对身体不好，心急乱了分寸，这就把你的人放回来。”

米樱昭雪被狼女恋恋不舍给送了回来，端木棠梨立即将人护到身后，阻断了对方觊觎的目光。

“小雪，大小姐对你真好，你可要好好照顾她。”

端木棠梨注意到狼女引导性极强的话语，担心多说多错，用手挠了挠自家小姐妹手心，示意小姐妹将人快点打发走。

米樱昭雪给了小姐妹一个放心眼神，开始自己的表演，听的狼女红眼病都要出来。

“那还用你说，我家大小姐是个顶顶好的主子，我为能有她这位主子而感到荣耀。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Miying Akira realized the mistake she had made, and quickly made up for it, changing the topic elsewhere.

"Well, I remember breakfast here is at six o'clock, lunch is at eleven o'clock, and dinner is at five o'clock. Each meal time is limited to one hour. Let's go to the restaurant to eat quickly. If we are late, we will be hungry."

The wolf girl stretched out her hands to pull away Mi Ying Zhaoxue who was behind Duanmu Tangli, and walked out along the aisle very quickly.

"Xiaoxue never said she wanted to go with you. It's so rude of you to just drag people away."

Duanmu Tangli thought the matter was over and relaxed for a moment. Then she realized something was wrong and brought it up again.

But she didn't expect that the monster would take advantage of her slight slack and use Mi Ying Zhaoxue's words to kidnap the person directly, which made her feel anxious.

If there was no Weirdness, why would the Weirdness drag the little sister out? There must be some death rules that she didn't know about, and she couldn't let people out.

Seeing that the person was about to be taken out of the box by the wolf girl, Duanmu Tangli had an idea and tried to use their death rules to deal with the ghost creatures.

If it works, they have a chance to survive in the other world.

"Don't be anxious, young lady. Your servant and I will get you something to eat right now."

Apparently the ghost creatures transformed from humans have a higher IQ than the original weird creatures in the other world.

Seeing that he could no longer drag the person away directly, he immediately thought of a way to coax Duanmu Tangli into hiding and drag Miying Zhaoxue away for a feast.

"Huh, who do you think you are? Why do I need you to point my fingers at what I do? Why don't you put my people down quickly?"

Seeing that Duanmu Tangli was too soft, he simply stiffened his hair and imitated the strong and powerful attitude of Fugui Zhenye just now, hoping that this would deter Weiyi and rescue his little friend.

Fortunately, Duanmu Tangli learned the lesson well, and like a real wealthy daughter, she was able to frighten the demons and monsters, cut off their greed for the body of her little friend, and reluctantly let him go.

"Miss, please don't be angry. I'm not worried about your health if you're hungry for a long time. I'm anxious and confused. I'll put your people back now."

Mi Ying Zhaoxue was reluctantly sent back by the wolf girl, and Duanmu Tangli immediately protected her behind her, blocking her coveted gaze.

"Xiaoxue, the eldest lady is so kind to you, you must take good care of her."

Duanmu Tangli noticed the very instructive words of the wolf girl and was worried that if she said too much, she would make a mistake. She scratched the palm of her little sister's hand and signaled her to send him away quickly.

Miying Zhaoxue gave the little sister a reassuring look and started her performance, which made the wolf girl have pink eye.

"It goes without saying that my eldest lady is a very good mistress. I feel honored to have her as my mistress."
